question: Can you provide the number of distinct active and closed bike share stations for each year 2013 and 2014?
sql:
WITH stations_2013 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT start_station_id AS station_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.austin_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_time) = 2013
),
stations_2014 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT start_station_id AS station_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.austin_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_time) = 2014
)
SELECT 
  2013 AS year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.status = 'active' THEN s.station_id END) AS active_stations,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.status = 'closed' THEN s.station_id END) AS closed_stations
FROM stations_2013 st
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.austin_bikeshare.bikeshare_stations` s ON st.station_id = s.station_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  2014 AS year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.status = 'active' THEN s.station_id END) AS active_stations,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.status = 'closed' THEN s.station_id END) AS closed_stations
FROM stations_2014 st
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.austin_bikeshare.bikeshare_stations` s ON st.station_id = s.station_id
ORDER BY year
